description: This file contains unit tests for the ChatLog component in a chat user interface, verifying behavior such as message capping, pruning, rendering, and handling of special message types.

classes.name: ChatLog
classes.description: A class representing a chat log component managing messages, pruning, rendering, and handling special message types.

methods.name: addSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the chat log.

methods.name: startAssistant
methods.description: Starts an assistant message sequence with given parameters.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates an existing assistant message sequence.

methods.name: startTool
methods.description: Adds a tool message to the chat log.

methods.name: updateToolResult
methods.description: Updates the result for a tool message.

methods.name: showBtw
methods.description: Displays a 'BTW' (by the way) message block.

methods.name: hasVisibleBtw
methods.description: Checks if a 'BTW' message is currently visible.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears chat history, optionally preserving pending user messages.

methods.name: restorePendingUsers
methods.description: Re-adds pending user messages after history rebuild.

methods.name: countPendingUsers
methods.description: Returns the count of pending user messages.

methods.name: commitPendingUser
methods.description: Marks a pending user message as committed, removing it from pending state.

methods.name: reconcilePendingUsers
methods.description: Reconciles pending user messages with provided history based on timestamps.
